snippet.title: Star Trek: Infection - Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Star Trek: Infection is an intense full-body VR, narrative survival experience set in the iconic Star Trek universe. 

In Star Trek: Infection, players step into the boots of a Vulcan Starfleet officer tasked with a covert mission aboard the U.S.S. Lumen where things quickly spiral into a psychological and physical nightmare.

Learn more and add Star Trek: Infection to your wishlist: 
- Meta: https://www.meta.com/pl-pl/experiences/star-trek-infection/6621524501230775/
- Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3954580/Star_Trek_Infection 

Follow us for more:
X/Twitter: @Played_WithFire
Instagram: @playedwithfire.games
YouTube: @playedwithfirevr
Discord: https://discord.com/invite/SjpgMekCeS

Music:
“In The Heart Of Evil” – composer: puremusic
